bible_verses.telugu: ఆదియందు వాక్యముండెను, వాక్యము దేవునియొద్ద ఉండెను, వాక్యము దేవుడై యుండెను.
bible_verses.english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

bible_verses.english: Therefore God exalted him to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name.

bible_verses.telugu: ఏలయనగా ఆకాశమందున్నవియు భూమియందున్న వియు, దృశ్యమైనవిగాని, అదృశ్యమైనవిగాని, అవి సింహాసనములైనను ప్రభుత్వములైనను ప్రధానులైనను అధికారములైనను, సర్వమును ఆయనయందు సృజింప బడెను, సర్వమును ఆయనద్వారాను ఆయననుబట్టియు సృజింపబడెను.
bible_verses.english: For in him all things were created: things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through him and for him.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, Your Name is truly above every other name, filled with matchless beauty, power, and grace. Thank You for revealing the hidden glory of God to us and for drawing near in love. As I sing Your Name today, align my heart with Your majesty and let my life reflect Your goodness. May I always find my peace, hope, and strength in You alone. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Before time began, Jesus was present as the eternal Word, holding all creation together in beauty and purpose. Yet, the deep majesty of God is no longer a distant mystery; it has been lovingly revealed to us through Christ. When we sing of His Name, we are praising the One who holds ultimate authority, yet draws near to redeem us. Let your heart rest today in the matchless beauty and supreme power of Jesus, our King.
